design.name: 鲲鹏
design.brief: Chapter boss Kun-Peng (鲲鹏) of the Zhuangzi, the great fish of the northern darkness that changes into a giant bird. This sheet shows its FIRST form, the Kun: a colossal ancient fish bursting up through the sea ice, a huge blunt armoured head with a wide mouth full of ice-tusk teeth and small wise ancient eyes glowing aqua-cyan, ink-blue scales edged with frost, long whisker barbels, and on its back the folded beginnings of enormous feathered wings breaking out of the scales (the Peng it will become); a glowing aqua-cyan pearl in its forehead (weak spot). Majestic and world-ending.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted shapes, scales and fins as big simple carved shapes. A boss: show the head, the front of the body and the first wing folds rising out of broken sea ice; the rest of the body stays under the ice.
design.turnaround_lead: Boss model, first form Kun (the body below the ice line is not drawn):
design.turnaround_pose: the great fish's head and front body rising straight up out of the ice and cut flat at the ground line (no ice shards, no splash around it), the head level and facing straight ahead, mouth closed showing the ice tusks, the forehead pearl painted opaque bright aqua-cyan (no halo), the whisker barbels hanging down, the folded feather-wing beginnings on its back as solid shapes
design.turnaround_digits: the whole head, barbels and back wings fully inside the frame.
